match_legacy.thread_intro:
${team1Ping} ${team2Ping}

**Match created**
• **Team 1:** {team1} ({team1Id})
• **Team 2:** {team2} ({team2Id})

Submit the score from this thread with:
`/result score1:<Team 1 score> score2:<Team 2 score>`

A registered player from each team must then confirm the submitted result. Only participants and staff can see this thread.
